stream_log.reasoning: Week of 2026-07-06 to 07-13. The dominant event is the collapse of the June US-Iran ceasefire (Islamabad Memorandum): on 7 July two tankers were struck in the Strait of Hormuz, the US reimposed oil sanctions and CENTCOM ran hundreds of strikes on Iranian military sites, Iran hit US bases in Kuwait/Jordan/Bahrain, and both sides openly contested control of the strait - Brent surged back above $78 and Hormuz traffic fell to ~6 crossings per 12h (vs 18-22 daily). Israel also breached its June Lebanon truce (deadly strikes on Nabatieh). This drives middle_east_stability 0.25->0.18, nuclear_risk_level 0.32->0.35, and supply_chain_resilience 0.55->0.52, and is recorded as a new node (2026_hormuz_crisis). Russia-Ukraine continued at high tempo (mass strikes on Kyiv for a third time in a week, ~20 killed on the eve of the NATO Ankara summit), adding to cumulative conflict_deaths (1,503,000->1,505,500) alongside the Gulf and Lebanon casualties. Excluded: continued frontier-AI releases (GPT-5.6, Grok 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro Deep Think) are real but do not warrant a second integer tick to ai_development_year_offset one week after it moved 4->5; equity markets stayed resilient (stocks up on the week, AI shares leading) with no systemic move, so no growth-modifier change; the Venezuela earthquake toll kept climbing but was already priced into latin_america_stability last week.

Week of 2026-07-13 to 07-20. The 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis deepened rather than resolved: on 14 July the US struck Iranian missile sites and defense systems and reinstated a full naval blockade of Iranian ports (CENTCOM confirmed 15 July), which held all week with no ceasefire. Brent surged +9.59% to $83.30 (highest since June 12) and the shock finally reached markets - S&P 500 -1.01%, Nasdaq -1.4% on the week - so middle_east_stability slips 0.18->0.15, supply_chain_resilience 0.52->0.48 (a major oil chokepoint blockaded for a sustained week), and for the first time global_gdp_growth_modifier ticks down 1.03->1.01 as the oil shock transmits into a soft-but-real growth hit with recession odds elevated. Russia-Ukraine ground on: Ukraine struck Salavat in Bashkortostan - Russia's last unhit major gasoline refinery - amid a recruitment shortfall (~195k of a 409k goal), nudging russia_stability 0.29->0.28, and sustained US-Iran combat plus the Ukraine/Lebanon fronts add to cumulative conflict_deaths (1,505,500->1,509,000). Excluded: continued frontier-AI releases (GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Grok 4.5, Moonshot Kimi K3) are offset by Google delaying Gemini 3.5 Pro and a ~9% semiconductor selloff on AI-valuation fears, so no further ai_development_year_offset tick; the European/North American heatwaves (~20k excess deaths) are severe but peaked in the prior window and map to no clean structural dimension; nuclear_risk_level already moved 0.32->0.35 last week and saw no fresh signaling to justify another step. This is a continuation/escalation of the existing 2026_hormuz_crisis node, not a new discrete event, so no new nodes.

Week of 2026-07-20 to 07-27. The 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis widened before turning: supply disruption spread from Hormuz to the Red Sea (a second major shipping chokepoint now contested for Saudi crude), oil surged ~40% on the month with Brent near $96-100, and after nearly two weeks of intensifying US bombing of Iran the very end of the week produced the first genuine de-escalation - the US paused strikes for two straight days (Jul 25-26), Iran reciprocated, and interim-ceasefire talks resumed via Oman/Pakistan/China mediation (Brent fell ~4% Friday to ~$97 on the news but stayed ~+10% on the week). The naval blockade nonetheless still held (ships redirected/disabled/boarded Saturday). Net: supply_chain_resilience 0.48->0.45 (second chokepoint disrupted), middle_east_stability 0.15->0.14 (Red Sea widening and peak-intensity bombing defined most of the week; the nascent, unconsummated pause keeps the slip small), global_gdp_growth_modifier 1.01->1.00 (sustained ~$100 oil bit harder - S&P -0.6%, Nasdaq -2% on the week, recession odds elevated), and nuclear_risk_level 0.35->0.34 (first mutual de-escalation in the conflict, though the blockade continues). Russia-Ukraine intensified on the deep-strike front: Ukraine flew one of its largest barrages (Russia claimed 571 drones downed in a night) and sparked a major fire at a Wildberries warehouse near St Petersburg, deepening fuel shortages and pressure on Putin, so russia_stability 0.28->0.27; two-front high-intensity combat (US-Iran bombing, Ukraine/Russia exchanges killing dozens, Lebanon) lifts cumulative conflict_deaths 1,509,000->1,512,500. Excluded: the frontier-AI wave continued (Claude Opus 5 on Jul 24, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Grok 4.5, Kimi K3 - '4 frontier models in 3 weeks') but does not warrant another integer ai_development_year_offset tick three weeks after the 4->5 move; the de-escalation is treated as a development within the existing 2026_hormuz_crisis node, not a new discrete event, so no new nodes - a signed ceasefire next week would be.

Week of 2026-07-27 to 08-03. The fragile Jul 25-26 pause in the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis collapsed rather than consummated into a ceasefire. Fighting re-escalated all week: Saudi Arabia joined US strikes on Iran-backed proxies (Jul 28), Iran fired a ballistic-missile attack on US forces (intercepted, Jul 29) prompting Trump to say it was 'our turn' as the US completed a fresh round of strikes, and Trump escalated coercion by vowing to bomb one Iranian bridge or power plant for every ship fired on in Hormuz - i.e. deliberate targeting of Iranian civilian infrastructure. The naval blockade held and Houthi/Red Sea attacks continued. This drives middle_east_stability 0.14->0.13 (war widened with Saudi direct involvement and civilian-infrastructure targeting) and reverses last week's tentative de-escalation on nuclear_risk_level 0.34->0.35 (pause broke, Iran struck US bases, Trump threats resumed). Notably the economic transmission eased even as the war intensified: Brent came off its ~$97-100 peak to ~$88 (still +~20% on the month) and equities rallied on strong megacap earnings (S&P 500 +1.1%, Nasdaq +1.6% on the week; Microsoft and Amazon jumped, though Apple -7.4% and Meta fell), so global_gdp_growth_modifier ticks back up 1.00->1.01 as the acute oil-shock drag partially unwound. Russia-Ukraine ground on with Ukraine's deep-strike campaign degrading Russian energy infrastructure further (drones hit ~13 more energy facilities Aug 2, causing local blackouts), sustaining fuel-shortage pressure on Moscow: russia_stability 0.27->0.26, and two-front high-intensity combat (US-Iran with Saudi involvement, daily Ukraine-Russia exchanges, Red Sea) lifts cumulative conflict_deaths 1,512,500->1,516,000. Excluded/watched: China's gray-zone squeeze on Taiwan intensified (China Coast Guard containment-rehearsal patrols east of Taiwan, a Jul 20 CCG clash injuring a Philippine sailor near Second Thomas Shoal, PLA drone-warfare training in Russia) but is an incremental campaign already partly reflected, with no discrete single-week trigger; the frontier-AI wave continued (Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, Kimi K3 at 2.8T params) but Google delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro and no event warrants another integer ai_development_year_offset tick weeks after the 4->5 move; seasonal monsoon flooding (Pakistan, Assam India ~5.6M affected) and European wildfires are regionally severe but map to no clean global structural dimension at meaningful magnitude. No new nodes: the re-escalation is a development within the existing 2026_hormuz_crisis node - a signed ceasefire, which did not materialize, would have warranted one.

Week of 2026-08-03 to 08-10. For the first time since the June ceasefire collapsed, the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis produced a substantive diplomatic framework rather than another failed pause: Iran and Oman announced agreement on a proposed shipping route (Aug 5-7) with a joint Tehran-Muscat statement in final drafting, Iran's FM Araghchi called a deal 'very close,' and Trump/Treasury Sec Bessent signaled a reopening 'soon.' Markets priced the de-escalation in hard - Brent fell more than 7% on the week (~$83-86) and the S&P 500 hit a record close Friday in its strongest week since April. This drives middle_east_stability 0.13->0.15 (framework deal emerging, though still subject to unmet conditions - Iran demands US compensation, troop withdrawal, war-end, and 5-7% transit fees, and a Houthi tanker strike still hit a Saudi vessel Aug 5), nuclear_risk_level 0.35->0.33 (positive/constructive talks reverse the prior re-escalation), supply_chain_resilience 0.45->0.47 (partial reopening close, oil easing) and global_gdp_growth_modifier 1.01->1.02 (acute oil-shock drag unwinding further as equities rallied to records). Russia-Ukraine ground on at record intensity - Russia set a wartime record of 381 missiles in July (~12/day), glide-bombed Zaporizhzhia (Aug 2) and continued deep strikes - while the US Senate passed a sweeping Russia sanctions package 86-11, adding fresh structural pressure even as Russian territorial gains slowed (13 sq mi in four weeks vs 31 prior): russia_stability 0.26->0.25. Sustained but de-escalating two-front combat lifts cumulative conflict_deaths 1,516,000->1,519,000. Excluded/watched: no new node - the emerging Hormuz deal was not signed this week (still in drafting, subject to conditions), so this remains a development within the existing 2026_hormuz_crisis node; a consummated ceasefire next week would warrant one. Also excluded: China's gray-zone squeeze on Taiwan continued (Aug 1 CCTV amphibious-assault footage, Taiwan-Strait live-fire drills, Taiwan's annual war games and a new $25B defense package) but is an incremental campaign with no discrete single-week trigger; the frontier-AI wave stayed incremental (ByteDance Seedance 2.5 Aug 8, Meta Muse Glimmer Aug 10) after late-July flagships (Claude Opus 5, Gemini 3.6 Flash) already counted, so no ai_development_year_offset tick; severe US wildfires (Spokane Complex ~60k evacuated, Oregon 2M+ acres, ~250k acres across Washington) and continuing South Asian monsoon flooding are regionally acute but map to no clean global structural dimension at meaningful magnitude.
